passages.text: Reason for consult: three weeks of progressive headache with new horizontal diplopia, referred by primary care.
Exam: partial left sixth cranial nerve palsy confirmed. Mild bilateral optic disc blurring on dilated fundoscopy, concerning for early papilledema.
No prior head CT or MRI on record.
Impression: findings raise concern for a space-occupying intracranial lesion with raised intracranial pressure. Contrast-enhanced imaging is needed to characterize a possible mass.
Plan: MRI brain without and with contrast (CPT 70553), to be performed on an expedited basis.
